title: Lorraine Registry of Multiple Sclerosis
summary: The RelSEP aims to register exhaustively every new case of multiple sclerosis (MS) occuring in Lorraine a French region, and follow up on them for an indefinite duration, registering disease evolution and intercurrent events.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Having a confirmed multiple sclerosis diagnosis
* Living in Lorraine (French region)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to be registered

sites.f: CIC 1433 Épidémiologie clinique, Inserm, Université de Lorraine, CHRU de Nancy
